reviews.x: This is so much better than the huge hanging bag I had before.  You cannot put regular size items in it, such as hairspray and shampoo, but it's perfect for travel-size items, cosmetics, medications, razors, etc.  And it folds so nicely. Sometimes you can even put more stuff in after folding, and it fits so nicely in my suitcase.

After my last travel bag was ruined by a spill, in a mesh pocket I am happy to receive this new bag with all plastic pouches.  The leather is soft and teal color is beautiful.  It came packed nicely with care.  The company sends you a pre-arrival email stating that the item is on it's way.  Just received a follow up email, about 5 days after I received it. I was pleasantly surprised with the quality and appearance of this toiletry bag!  I have been looking for a quality toiletry bag to take when we travel and to use at home as a way to sort out various cosmetic type items and this more than surpasses my expectations.  It is high quality and has a variety of compartments and areas in which to store toiletries.  Appearance wise, it also looks great.  Another bonus is being able to hang it so it is easier to use.  I highly recommend this toiletry bag

Like the color!  I like the fact that when fully opened, I can see all the contents. One of the pouches is detachable so that would make it easier when going through the TSA security.  The zippers are YKK same as what Coach uses on their bags. The clear plastic is soft.  The bag arrived in a nice inner box—nice touch! reviews.t: Cute and practical, but the hanger tore off after multiple uses
reviews.x: Love this bag. It's very cute and has enough room for everything I need when I travel (which is frequently.) It always zips up even when I fill it up pretty well. I recommend.  Update- after pretty extensive use the hanger tore off from the plastic which not only aesthetically takes away from it, but also functionally. Loved it until that happened, they just need to reinforce the area that it hangs from and it will be perfect!

Unfortunately, I have to return this bag because it came with a huge rip on the handle :( There was also a blue permanent marker mark on it. Super disappointing.  I will be ordering another one because I love the bag but I'm hoping this does not happen again!!!

I love this bag. The quality is great. It's so convenient and holds more than you'd expect. Although it may not hold regular sized shampoos, etc.. it is meant for travel. So, it's perfect for travel-size items. It fits so nicely inside my suitcase.
This is a nice looking bag, but both the zipper pull on one of the inner pouches, and one of the outer zippers broke the second day into my trip.  Unfortunately, it's not useable at this point.
Great color and plenty of room. Quality could be better. Rolled edges look like they are sewn imperfectly. If you want a high end bag,  this is not it! But for the price, it is fine
Appears to be exactly as advertised. Everything fits. I keep mine packed so I can just grab it and go when a trip comes up. I haven’t actually used it other than to pack it.

I was super excited to receive this. I had planned on bringing this on our cruise. As you can see it came dirty. SO NOT happy about this!

reviews.t: So i got this to have more room for my makeup if i leave it open its fine but trying to close it is a different story.
reviews.x: It was very cute but mine came compleatly smooshed so that was a little disappointing

reviews.t: I finally found the perfect toiletry bag for traveling
reviews.x: Finally giving up on my old hanging toiletry case because it was canvas and heavy and it took up too much room in my suitcase. Read countless reviews on Amazon and purchased this along with one other case that I thought looked promising. This one beat out the other by a longshot. The (aqua) color is cute, the zippered compartments allow you to easily view what is inside while providing easy assess via the zippers and the soft outside conforms more easily to my packed luggage while still holding

I needed to replace my old 4 section hanging Baggallini toiletry bag that rolled up (including a removable section that snapped on) which finally tore after 15 years. It is no longer made unfortunately. So I ordered a few options to consider before deciding on this bag. I like to lay toiletry bags fairly flat in my carryon luggage and this bag seems easy to open up and configure to lay flat or can be closed up into a zipped carrying case. It was large enough to carry all of my travel toiletries

reviews.t: With a small mod, best bag I've had yet!
reviews.x: Really loving it!  I use it for my makeup case.  The zippers at the top of each pouch are WAY better than the rollups with the triangular pouches, where the zippers are in the middle when hung.  Stuff always fell out of those, and of course makeup breaks when you drop it so you have a mess.  This is much better.  They're more voluminous than you can appreciate in the photo, and in spite of how much you can fit in, it still closes up to be no larger than a kid's school-style lunchbox!  I can also

I have all my make-up and brushes and such in the top 2 sections and the rest of my toiletries and other needs (band aids, hair supplies, jewelry, meds) in the bottom section. It holds it all and has been very durable through my many trips. My last bag started to come a part after just a few trips and the 3 compartments were awkward to fold up for travel. I travel all the time! I’ve been looking to replace a bag that’s held a lot of product and while keeping it in a small pack in suitcase.  This case holds a lot! Big bottles,  as well as keeping small things organized and easily visable. I just took on a trip- nicely packed and easy to access.  It fit nicely in my bag and could fold it up and not have it in the way of other people trying to get ready. I normally like black- but got the blue and it’s easy to spot in bag. reviews.t: Perfect for traveling with a bazillion products
reviews.x: This toiletry bag is awesome! I got the turquoise and the color and material is very nice. The compartments are wider and taller than they look and I was able to fit all of my travel toiletries, which I admit is a ridiculous amount for a trip, with no closing or zipper issues. Never knew I needed a hanger bag but I'd never go back now, so easy to see everything and grab it with the bag hanging. The compartments are clear and plastic so if anything leaks it won't ruin whatever else you have packe

I gave it 4 stars only because I was a bit disappointed that it was not like my old one.  I intend to keep this one.  It is good quality and looks very nice.  MY old one was wider at 13" and had more zipper pockets.  I  travel a lot.  I keep a hang-up travel manager like this one filled and ready to go at all times.  These types of products keep the bathroom neat and organized for me where ever I go.  This one will do, since my old one is wearing out. . .

This is nice travel bag for my toiletries.  I can't speak to weather or not it keeps liquids from seeping out, fortunately I didn't have any spills. I did find that it got full rather quickly, but I did have a few full size items, but didn't have any problems zipping it up. I appreciate having one of the pouches be detachable and the hanging hook, both provide convenience. Overall, I Iike this bag and will continue to use it for travel.

This bag is the perfect tiffany shade and is easy to transport. I also love that it is not super structured making it easy to fit into other luggages while still having enough support as to not crush my products. I've had other make up bags in the past but love this one because of the many many different pockets it has. Perfect amount of space and has amazing little pockets to fit everything I need.

I received my bag today and I love the color! It seems very spacious and should hold my make-up, some hair and face products for back and forth to the camper and when we go on trips. I can have everything in one place and zip it up to go! I love that i can hang it over the door when there isnt ebough counter space! It seems sturdy and well-made so I will update as i use it as far a durability!

reviews.t: Perfect for a longer trip! (and short ones too)
reviews.x: Purchased this for a 2 week trip to Greece, knowing that bathrooms are smaller in Europe and therefore it's not always possible to lay out a cosmetic case.  This wonderful bag has a hook and sure enough I needed to hang it most of the time. I thought the multiple compartments might be overkill and was concerned that when full it might be difficult to zip, but it compresses beautifully.

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the bag's quality, appearance, and color, describing it as high quality and beautiful.
Many reviewers find it holds more than expected and is perfect for travel-size items, though some note it cannot fit regular-size items like shampoo or hairspray.
Several customers report durability problems, including the hanger tearing or ripping off and zippers breaking after limited use.
A few reviewers received the bag damaged, dirty, or misshapen on arrival.
Some customers note imperfect sewing and say the quality could be better for a high-end feel.
